sources.title: National Security Council travel guidance and statutory destination prohibitions
sources.publisher: National Security Council, State of Israel
sources.officialityEvidence: The gov.il page is published by Israel's National Security Council.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Israeli citizens may not visit Syria, Lebanon, Saudi Arabia, Yemen or Iraq, including Kurdistan, under the law.

sources.title: Visas
sources.publisher: Consulate General of the Arab Republic of Egypt in London
sources.officialityEvidence: The page identifies itself as the Egyptian Consulate General in London and gives its official consular contacts.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Israel nationals are required to obtain clearance; after clearance, documents are provided to issue the visa.

sources.title: List of Visa on Arrival, visa-exemption, and Calling Visa subjects
sources.publisher: Directorate General of Immigration, Ministry of Immigration and Corrections
sources.officialityEvidence: The official imigrasi.go.id regional Directorate General of Immigration site publishes the list.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Nationals of listed countries, including Israel, must obtain Immigration Directorate approval before a visa is issued.

sources.title: New visa tariffs in the Republic of Chad
sources.publisher: Direction of Immigration and Emigration, Chad
sources.officialityEvidence: The evisa.td notice identifies the Chad Direction of Immigration and Emigration and cites Decree 2299/2025.
sources.supportingExcerpt: All new visa applications must be submitted exclusively through the official evisa.td platform.

sources.title: GEN 1.3 — Entry, Transit and Departure of Passengers and Crew
sources.publisher: Syrian General Authority of Civil Aviation
sources.officialityEvidence: The Syrian GACA electronic Aeronautical Information Publication identifies the issuing authority.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Entry visa obtained in advance from a Syrian diplomatic mission, unless exempt.
